title: The Trooper (2015 Remaster)
lyrics:
[00:36.34] You'll take my life, but I'll take yours too
[00:39.34] You'll fire your musket, but I'll run you through
[00:42.58] So when you're waiting for the next attack
[00:45.54] You'd better stand, there's no turning back
[00:48.61] The bugle sounds, the charge begins
[00:51.67] But on this battlefield, no one wins
[00:54.52] The smell of acrid smoke and horses' breath
[00:57.92] As I plunge on into certain death
[01:02.02] 
[01:36.34] The horse, he sweats with fear, we break to run
[01:39.46] The mighty roar of the Russian guns
[01:42.37] And as we race towards the human wall
[01:45.39] The screams of pain as my comrades fall
[01:48.38] We hurdle bodies that lay on the ground
[01:51.32] And the Russians fire another round
[01:54.12] We get so near, yet so far away
[01:57.08] We won't live to fight another day
[02:01.22] 
[03:23.08] We get so close, near enough to fight
[03:26.00] When a Russian gets me in his sights
[03:28.80] He pulls the trigger and I feel the blow
[03:31.66] A burst of rounds take my horse below
[03:34.43] And as I lay there gazing at the sky
[03:37.46] My body's numb and my throat is dry
[03:40.52] And as I lay forgotten and alone
[03:43.35] Without a tear, I draw my parting groan
[03:45.18]
